description: The Saarland surveying and geoinformation office LVGL offers a WMS layer, Solarpotential 2021, that visualises the solar potentials of the German state of Saarland within the state spatial data infrastructure. The service is registered in the INSPIRE-based national catalogue, and its metadata were modified on 12 May 2026. Its terms reserve all rights to LVGL: viewing within LVGL online applications or GeoPortal.Saarland is available free of charge, while any further use, including embedding in other applications or download, is subject to a fee and needs a contract with LVGL, which gives a telephone contact. The layer abstract states only that it visualises Saarland solar potentials, and the capabilities list the layer group Solarpotentiale and the 2021 layer. Coverage is the Saarland, Germany. Caveats: the method, resolution and whether roofs or open land are assessed are not described in the service metadata, and reuse beyond viewing is paid. Simulation uses are local solar potential as context for rooftop PV and distribution planning in Saarland. Related records: data-ch-rpv300-rooftop-pv-profiles-switzerland is an openly licensed rooftop PV dataset.
